# Orbit

> Orbit is a native desktop client for the pi coding agent. Chat, tools,
> review, Git, providers, and usage in one window — the same sessions as the
> terminal.

Orbit (also written "Orbit Pi") is a free, open-source workbench built in Rust
with GPUI, the GPU-accelerated UI framework from the Zed editor. It drives the
pi CLI you already have installed over pi's RPC interface; it does not bundle or
replace pi, and it uses your existing pi configuration and sessions.

## Key facts

- Platform: macOS 13+, Windows, Linux
- Built with: Rust + GPUI — a native app, no Electron or web view
- License: Apache-2.0; free, no account, no subscription
- Data: local-first; anonymous, opt-out product analytics only
- Interface: keyboard-first, native theming and fonts, integrated terminal

## Features

- Multiple pi sessions and workspaces in one window
- Inline diff review with per-turn checkpoints
- Git and GitHub: issues, pull requests, merges, branch checkout
- Model providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, OpenCode Go, Ollama, and custom
  endpoints
- Usage and quota analytics: tokens, cached tokens, sessions, workspaces
- MCP servers, skills, and plugins
- Native settings, appearance, and access modes (Supervised, Auto-accept, Full)
